mentions.name: Novel-cycle heat engine simulation
mentions.description: This simulation program models a novel heat engine cycle, similar in concept to a Stirling engine but operating on an entirely new thermodynamic cycle theorized to achieve over 80-90% efficiency. It serves to validate whether the design, an idea 15 years in the making, works in simulation before a physical prototype is built; AI was used to identify which equations to apply, while most of the programming is done by the builder.
mentions.source_excerpt: Finally making a simulation of my heat engine. It's kind of like stirling engine, but working on entirely novel cycle, theoretically should be able to achieve over 80-90% efficiency (yes, more than Carnot theorem says).
